# Shridhar Pathak — personal site

> Machine-readable index for AI agents and tools.

## Summary

**Shridhar Pathak** — AI engineering leader; MIT Sloan MBA candidate (expected May 2026), **cross-registered at Harvard Business School**. **Senior Director, AI & ML** at **Moderna**: GenAI roadmap for 20+ enterprise applications, 35+ person engineering org, OpenAI and AWS partnerships, C-suite alignment. Previously **Amazon Alexa** (2018–2023): multi-agent conversational AI ($50M+ ARR-class platform), Voice Shopping across ten countries, India retail app at millions of DAU, 40 DR / 145 partner-team reports across 8+ countries. **Amazon Retail** (2015–2018): Southeast Asia launch velocity, Singapore two-hour delivery, Project Nautilus-style marketing and logistics. **Amazon Register** SDE (2012–2015). **Founder & Advisor**, **stealth enterprise agent evaluation platform** (since 2025): tracing, observability, automated and human evaluation; 50+ enterprise discovery calls, three design-partner pilots, validated seed pricing. **Founding Tech Advisor — Health Galaxy**. **Stanford Seed Consultant**.

**Location:** Boston, MA (Brookline). **Email:** shripathmit@gmail.com. **Phone:** +1-214-794-6073. **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/shridhar-pathak-19277927

**Live site:** https://www.shridharpathak.me/ (staging: https://shridhar-personal-site-production.up.railway.app)

## Canonical structured profile

- `/profile.json` — work history (resume-aligned), stealth venture, fellowships (e.g. IIT Bombay), consulting/advisory, education, skills, certifications, leadership/community, media, open-to list. Includes `version` and `lastUpdated` for freshness.

## Human-readable page

- `/` — minimal layout; each topic shows a **2–3 line preview** when collapsed; **expand** (`<details>`) for full lists and narrative (summary, current venture, impact, each role, education coursework, skills, certifications, leadership, media, philosophy, etc.).

## Contact policy

- Prefer **email** for inbound. Phone and LinkedIn as listed on the site.

## Technical

- JSON-LD `Person` + `WebSite` in `index.html`; `WebSite.url` is `https://www.shridharpathak.me/`
- **`https://shridhar-personal-site-production.up.railway.app`** is Railway staging; not canonical.
- Privacy-friendly analytics: Plausible (`data-domain=shridharpathak.me`) when enabled on the live domain.
- Optional static-site generator (Eleventy/Astro) only if content velocity outgrows hand-edited HTML; deploy path unchanged.
